polls.description: China is launching a massive $295 billion AI infrastructure push while facing increasing restrictions from the US and allies on chip access.
polls.question: Will China's $295B AI buildout succeed despite Western chip restrictions?

cluster_stories.title: Taiwan Mulls Curbs on AI Chip Exports to China to Align With US
cluster_stories.summary: Taiwan authorities are considering much stricter export controls on AI chip sales to China to further align with US measures, according to people familiar with the matter, an effort to address semiconductor smuggling that risks drawing a rebuke from Beijing.
cluster_stories.headline: TAIWAN MULLS AI CHIP EXPORT CURBS... Aligning With US Against China

cluster_stories.title: PRC-linked influence operations are targeting AI debates in the US
cluster_stories.summary: A new report from OpenAI details PRC-linked influence operations using AI to target U.S. tech debates, data center narratives, tariffs, and false claims about ChatGPT.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI EXPOSES Chinese AI Influence Operations

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Says China-Linked Accounts Aim to Fuel US Data Center Pushback
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI said a group of ChatGPT accounts with ties to China have sought to stir up local opposition to data centers in the US in a potential bid to hinder the country’s competitiveness in artificial intelligence, echoing recent rhetoric from others in the tech industry.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI: China-Linked Accounts Target US Data Centers

cluster_stories.title: Taiwan Eyes China AI Chip Sales Curbs; OpenAI Files for IPO | Bloomberg Tech 6/09/2026
cluster_stories.summary: Bloomberg’s Caroline Hyde discusses why Taiwan is weighing some of its toughest restrictions yet on AI chip sales to China, and OpenAI joining its AI rivals with plans for a potential public listing later this year. Plus, Apple lays the foundation for the AI era and hints at the company's upcoming foldable iPhone. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: TAIWAN WEIGHS TOUGHEST AI CHIP CURBS YET; OPENAI FILES IPO

cluster_stories.title: China Preps $295 Billion Plan to Fund AI Buildout
cluster_stories.summary: China is planning to spend around 2 trillion yuan ($295 billion) over the next five years to build data centers across the country. Neil Campling reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA PREPS $295 BILLION AI BUILDOUT... Massive Data Center Push
